First, we find the principal value:

$$
\begin{aligned}x=\operatorname{arccos}⁡(-\frac{3}{7})=2.013\,707…≈2.0137\end{aligned}
$$

Since $2.0137$ lies inside the specified domain, our first solution, rounded to one decimal place, is $x=2.0.$

Our first solution lies in the second quadrant and has a reference angle of 

$$
{\theta }_{R}=\pi -2.0137≈1.1279.
$$

Since $\operatorname{cos}⁡x<0,$ the second solution must lie in the third quadrant, and it also has a reference angle ${\theta }_{R}=1.1279.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13952163/assets/157096afa9d3de44710dfa11c99f1f699815156fbcd5d649c1b4048dbbba9913.png)

Since the second solution $x$ lies in the $3$rd quadrant, we can find it using the reference angle as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & =\pi +{\theta }_{R} \\  & =\pi +1.1279 \\  & ≈4.3\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, arranged in ascending order, the solutions are $x=2.0$ and $x=4.3.$
